Galaxy put the reading above the 99th percentile of all daily counts since 2009, without naming a single app or cohort as the cause. NEW: BLOCKSTREAM SAYS LIQUID NETWORK RESTART IS BEING PREPARED. Following the recent security incident and movement of funds, Blockstream says updated software has been deployed as Liquid Federation members prepare for a coordinated network restart. The company says its teams remain focused on further hardening the network and ensuring the return of assets. Blockstream thanked the Bitcoin community for its patience, support, advice, and assistance, and said further updates will follow. Source: https://x.com/bitcoinnewscom/status/2097129152306450529
